def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    p = divs[0]
    out = [list(r) for r in g]
    bounds, prev = [], 0
    for d in divs + [h]:

        prev = d + 1
    for s, e in bounds[1:]:
        for k in range(s, min(e, s + p)):
            out[k] = list(g[k - s])
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # horizontal divider rows and vertical divider cols (uniform, non-bg)
    hdiv = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i])) == 1 and g[i][0] != bg]
    vdiv = [j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][j] != bg]
    vset = set(vdiv)
    # sections (row bands between horizontal dividers)
    bounds, prev = [], 0
    for d in hdiv + [h]:
        if d > prev: bounds.append((prev, d))
        prev = d + 1
    out = [list(r) for r in g]
    # collect objects per section: (rel_row, col, color), excluding divider cols
    objs = {}
    for si, (s, e) in enumerate(bounds):
        cells = [(i - s, j, g[i][j]) for i in range(s, e) for j in range(w)
                 if g[i][j] != bg and j not in vset]
        if cells: objs[si] = cells
    # column bands between vertical dividers
    vb, vp = [], 0
    for d in vdiv + [w]:
        if d > vp: vb.append((vp, d))
        vp = d + 1
    def band(j):
        for a, b in vb:
            if a <= j < b: return (a, b)
    for si, cells in objs.items():
